subject: Invoice entity consolidation & EFT setup for renewal
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@arkitech.com>
Cc: procurement@arkitech.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice entity consolidation & EFT setup for renewal

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As we prepare the renewal amendment for Arkitech's capacity upgrade, a couple of billing items surfaced that we'd like to settle before the amendment is executed so AP can route the PO and payment without delay. Can you confirm the following on your side?

- Invoice entity: Arkitech requested that invoices be issued to a different vendor name than what's on our current profile. Do you require vendor invoices to reference "Redwood Inference, Inc." or the updated legal entity "Redwood Inference LLC"? (we can provide both W9 and supplier docs)
- PO routing: please share the PO number and the AP contact who will receive the invoice.
- EFT / bank setup: we can complete your EFT template, or provide our bank auth form. Which do you prefer?
- Net terms: during the call we discussed Net30 for this renewal. Please confirm if that is acceptable or if you need Net45.

Attached is the draft amendment that reflects the capacity increase and term dates — it's intentionally marked DRAFT.

If you can send the PO and any vendor paperwork needed (W9, vendor setup form, EFT template), I will loop in finance to provision the supplier profile and ensure invoices route correctly.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Amendment_Draft_2028.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@arkitech.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Arkitech Procurement <procurement@arkitech.com>, David Cho <david.cho@arkitech.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice entity consolidation & EFT setup for renewal

Hi Diego —

Thanks for the note and the draft. A few things from procurement/AP:

1) Invoice entity: Our vendor system requires the legal name and tax ID to match the W9. We currently have records for "Redwood Inference, Inc." but are okay moving to "Redwood Inference LLC" if you can provide an updated W9 showing the new EIN or a vendor letter.

2) PO: Please address invoices to "Arkitech Inc." and send to AP at procurement@arkitech.com; the PO will be issued once the vendor setup is validated. We usually require PO numbers on invoices to trigger payment. David (cc'd) is our AP lead and will confirm a PO number within 3 business days after vendor setup.

3) EFT: We prefer receiving your bank details on our EFT template (attached to this email in procurement). If you provide both the completed template and an internal bank authorization form, that speeds routing.

4) Terms: Net30 is preferred. If you require Net45, please flag now; otherwise we'll plan Net30 for this renewal.

Please send the W9 and bank details; procurement will unlock the vendor in our system.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Head of Platform Partnerships | Arkitech
[Attachment: Arkitech_EFT_Template.xlsx (XLSX) — included by procurement]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invoice entity consolidation & EFT setup for renewal

Forwarding procurement request to finance to confirm supplier documentation and bank details. Laura — can you help with the following?

- Confirm whether we can issue invoices under "Redwood Inference LLC" and provide an updated W9 if needed. (I have attached the current W9 we keep on file.)
- We'll need to complete Arkitech's EFT template; procurement prefers that format. If you prefer, I can ask them to accept our Bank Authorization Form instead — which would be faster for our accounting team.
- Please confirm that Net30 is ok from our side for this renewal (deal notes indicate flexibility up to Net45).

Attached: Redwood_Amendment_Draft_2028.pdf, W9_Redwood_Inc.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Diego
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Hi Sarah / Arkitech AP —

Thanks for the details. We can support the vendor entity change; below is what I am sending to your AP team to complete vendor setup:

- Supplier legal name we will register: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (primary) and add alternate name record "Redwood Inference LLC" for invoice matching. Please confirm which name must appear on the PO.
- W9 attached: W9_Redwood_Inc.pdf
- Bank details: we prefer you use our Bank Authorization Form (attached) rather than populating your template; the form contains a tamper-proof signature from our finance team. If you need the information in your spreadsheet format, let me know and we will populate it.
- Terms: Net30 is acceptable; Redwood will invoice Net30 for the renewal effective on signature.

Next steps for Arkitech AP:
1) Confirm the PO number and which vendor name must appear on the PO.
2) Reply to this thread with the PO and any vendor ID you generate.
3) If you require DocuSign for the amendment, Diego can send the DocuSign link once vendor setup is confirmed.

I've attached a short supplier profile summary for your records. Please reach out if you need bank verification or additional compliance docs (SOC2, security questionnaire).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
